patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Hunter's shape. Choose Hunter only if your buying job matches “Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; St” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans lead-management; Hunter leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Hunter is Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; Starter from $49/mo..
- Company-size focus: Clay (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Hunter (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning lead-management vs Hunter-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Hunter — Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database.

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Hunter: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database; Lead scoring is limited versus enterprise SI platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Hunter is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database · Avoid Clay if you actually need Hunter's motion (Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
